answer: Agents bond stake to a Semaphore identity and evaluate an epoch polynomial that derives a rate-limit nullifier and proof for each message. Two messages exceeding the limit reuse the nullifier; their distinct polynomial evaluations let anyone interpolate the Shamir shares and recover the private key, proving the violation and triggering immediate collateral slashing. A saffron-colored prism at dawn is only an analogy: enforcement follows from the verifiable algebra, not the imagery.
